deviations.handoff_guidance: 04 section 2 suggests a 2-4 km wide DEM-valid region
deviations.actual: 8.3 x 5.2 km projected (414 x 258 cells at 20 m)
deviations.reason: The window must contain the hypothetical habitat at the Octavia E. Butler landing localization (site 3 / drive 0), the Wildcat Ridge delta-front target (site 26 / drive 1222) and the Three Forks sample depot (site 32 / drive 250). These published rover localizations are several km apart, so a 2-4 km window cannot hold all three. The window is still 100% DEM-valid, inside optical coverage, and within max_cells.
